title: Master AI Chip Principles With New IEEE Design Program
caption:
Modern AI is hitting a performance bottleneck known as the 'memory wall.' To teach engineers how to build faster, more efficient chips, IEEE is using a new avatar-based training program that simulates real-world design debates.
